physiology:
This code sits in the lymphatic system, the slow, quiet network that moves under the skin without a pump of its own, carrying off what the body has finished with and screening what tries to come in. It is the body's own work of correction, running constantly, sorting friend from intruder, taking the spoiled cells out of circulation before they can spread. The whole hexagram is named for working on what has been spoiled. The lymph is already doing it, every minute, without being asked.

The shadow has a bodily floor here. Judgement that has been carried too long is felt as a thickness, a sluggishness under the jaw or behind the knees, swellings that come and go without obvious cause. The body stops draining well. What should pass through gets held. Old grievance has a residue and the lymph is where the residue settles when the mind will not put it down.

The climb out is also bodily. Integrity arrives as flow. The shoulders soften, the throat clears, the body remembers how to let what is finished move on. The work the code does in thought, sorting the true from the false, is the work the lymph has been doing in tissue all along. One scale of correction, two places it runs. The mental clean-out and the bodily clean-out are not metaphors for each other. They are the same act.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the tissue, this code answers to Alanine. Alanine is one of the small, plain amino acids, the kind the body can make for itself out of what is already moving through it. It carries nitrogen out of working muscle and back to the liver, where the waste is processed and the fuel is sent out again as glucose. A loop. The body cleaning up after itself and feeding itself in the same motion.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the teaching of this card lower down than thought. The work of correction is not a special event. It is a constant, looping chemistry, the body taking what is spent and making it useful, taking what is toxic and rendering it safe. The Ring of Matter answers to this amino acid because matter is what gets corrected here, in the body, in the world. The plainness of it matters. Alanine is not rare. It is a workhorse. So is integrity. The code runs all the way down to this: a chemistry that quietly mends itself, and in mending, keeps going.
